scope: Research evidence screening, not model validation or pilot participation.

datasets.citation: Barro, Mariam; Wonni, Issa; Tollenaere, Charlotte (2021). Soil Physicochemical Properties in rice fields from six sites in western Burkina Faso, 2018. DataSuds, V1.
datasets.audit_role: Laboratory transcription and source-definition review only.
limitations: Rice-field chemistry is not an irrigation-event time series or validation of vegetable irrigation.
Per-sample collection/report dates, daily weather and applied irrigation are absent from the numeric table.
Dictionary contains inconsistent site-count and potassium-ion wording; retain original definitions for clarification.
No automatic soil-test interpretation, soil-water initialization or fertilizer targets are justified.

datasets.citation: Afshar, Somayeh; Ramezani, Mohsen; Mollazade, Kaveh; Moradiani, Atefe (2026). IrriDrone: Overhead Drone-Based Video Dataset for Precision Sprinkler Irrigation Assessment. Zenodo, version 1.0.
datasets.audit_role: Discharge metadata and evaluation-split preparation only; no videos downloaded.
limitations: Iranian fields do not establish Burkina Faso or Taiwan performance.
Relative pressure categories cannot become measured pressure/head inputs.
Wind was not instrumentally measured; the numeric table lacks surveyed pipes, nozzle curves and collection-can distributions.
Paired recordings must stay together in any future evaluation split; no split or prediction test has been performed.
Dates and local times are retained as supplied; no timezone or date-order interpretation is inferred.

datasets.citation: Yang, Dan-Hong; Chang, Jui-Tse; Yang, Kai-Wen et al. (2026). Soybean aphid population dynamics and soil moisture in soybean fields: data and code. Dryad.
datasets.audit_role: Candidate only; publication metadata and README inspected, numeric archive unavailable in this audit.
limitations: The README describes daily sensor summaries; these are not instantaneous end-of-day soil-state readings.
Actual CSV columns, missingness, sensor depth and units have not been inspected.
No timestamps, observation quality or irrigation validation metrics are fabricated.
